parameters.query: with cur as (select (select value from settings where key = 'deep_running') as v), ok as (select coalesce(nullif(v, ''), '1970-01-01')::timestamptz < now() - interval '16 minutes' as ok from cur), upd as (insert into settings (key, value, updated_at) select 'deep_running', now()::text, now() from ok where ok.ok on conflict (key) do update set value = excluded.value, updated_at = excluded.updated_at returning 1) select (select ok from ok) as ok, (select count(*) from upd) as took
